prompt: we've got a pnpm monorepo (apps/web is React, apps/api is Fastify, there's already a packages/types). i just wrote a zod schema for the signup form that validates emails and password strength — both the web form and the api endpoint need it. also the api has all the prisma models in apps/api/src, and my teammate wants to move them into a shared package so the web app can import them directly. where should these two things go? fyi we have exactly one frontend app, no design system.
assertions: Places the zod schema in a runtime shared package (e.g. packages/shared), distinguishing it from the type-only packages/types — with reasoning, not just a destination
Rejects moving Prisma models into a shared package, keeping them in apps/api, and explains the coupling cost (ORM/db concerns dragged into the frontend, deploy coupling)
Offers the DTO route as the sharing mechanism: expose user shapes via packages/types so the frontend gets types, not models
Gives a direct answer to the package.json question implicitly or explicitly: no packages/ui scaffolding recommended for a single frontend app, and the answer stays advice (no project scaffolding)
